description.en: Registers an item name substitution for the given placeholder index, so the next opened message can embed an item's name at that placeholder.
Index of the placeholder within the message text to substitute.
ID of the item whose name to insert.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Substitute an item's name into the next message's placeholder 0
CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_ITEM(0, itemID);
